q: What do SMA-0, SMA-1 and SMA-2 mean on my MSME loan, and what does the bank do next?
title: SMA-0, SMA-1 and SMA-2 on an MSME loan
short: They are early warning stages before a loan becomes an NPA. Under RBI's MSME revival framework, SMA-1 means principal or interest is 31 to 60 days overdue and SMA-2 means 61 to 90 days. SMA-0 means not more than 30 days overdue but showing signs of stress. Every SMA-2 account must be examined for a corrective action plan.
audience: MSME owners with term loans or cash credit, and their finance staff

ul: SMA-0: principal or interest not overdue for more than 30 days, but the account shows signs of incipient stress.
SMA-1: principal or interest overdue for 31 to 60 days.
SMA-2: principal or interest overdue for 61 to 90 days.

sections.h: Signs that can put you in SMA-0
ul: Stock statements or financial statements delayed by 90 days or more.
Sales or operating profit 40% or more below the projections the loan was sanctioned on.
Drawing power cut by 20% or more after a stock audit.
Three or more cheques or debit instructions returned in 30 days for lack of balance.
A third request for more time to create security or meet a sanction condition.

p: For loan limits above ₹10 lakh, the branch must send the account to the bank's Committee for Stressed MSMEs, normally within five working days. For limits up to ₹10 lakh, the branch manager or a designated official must examine it. Recovery as the chosen option needs the committee's agreement.

ul: Rectification: you commit to clear the overdue with identifiable cash flows, sometimes with short ad hoc finance.
Restructuring: if the business is viable and you are not a wilful defaulter.
Recovery: only when the first two are not feasible.

p: The framework covers MSMEs with loan limits up to ₹25 crore, and you do not have to wait for the bank. You can apply yourself if you see trouble coming.

senseible: Senseible does not see or report loan status. If high fuel or power costs are part of the stress, its bill-based records show where the energy money goes.
